scope: 2018-2021 SEC candidate clusters; 25 selected substantive announcements, not a complete deal census.
retrieval_timestamp_semantics: retrieved_at records completion of the web primary-source review batch; individual HTTP transfer timestamps were not captured.
label_definition: Definitive whole-company change-of-control announcement. Agreement execution, offer commencement, rumors, nonbinding proposals and completion are distinct events.
model_feature_policy: Acquisition announcements and later corroborating documents may establish labels and identity only. They must never supply historical pre-announcement feature values.
negative_control_policy: No nonacquired controls are created in this review file. Unreviewed candidates and missing deal matches are not negative labels.

primary_source.title: Celgene Corporation to Acquire Juno Therapeutics, Inc., Advancing Global Leadership in Cellular Immunotherapy
primary_source.reviewed_content_locator: Opening dateline and Terms of the Agreement
primary_source.evidence_paraphrase: The joint release announces a board-approved definitive merger agreement at $87 per share in cash. The terms specify a tender for every outstanding Juno common share, including a plan to buy shares not already held by Celgene; the stated prior Celgene interest is about 9.7%.

public_listing.evidence: The contemporaneous issuer release explicitly identifies Juno Therapeutics, Inc. as Nasdaq JUNO.

target_identity.basis: SEC candidate filer identity and archive CIK, matched by legal company name to reviewed announcement; not inferred from current ticker mappings.

limitations: Source-reviewed by Codex; not independently adjudicated by a human. Date is the sourced definitive-announcement calendar date; intraday publication time and exhaustive earliest-publication search were not established. Status is pending as described at announcement, not a present-day deal-status claim. Control percent means proposed post-transaction ownership, not acceptance threshold or the incremental stake purchased. Announcement evidence is a label only, never a pre-event feature.
